dispositions.reason: The replacement uses the current reviewed Acid Arrow procedure: rank 2, base 3 RP, Action, 30 ft, ranged spell attack, 4d4 initial acid and one finite 2d4 delayed rider. Spell Shield redirects the same pending spell without creating a replacement damage root or changing caster/dealer identity; the original root is created only at Acid Arrow's actual damage checkpoint and descendant rider damage inherits that root flag.

Current Druid Master of Winter is a bounded winter invocation with spellRank null and is not evidence for a free ordinary Control Weather cast. Wizard 20 Grand Reservoir is the unambiguous current source: it waives only the chosen spell's normal/base RP cost, so the accepted Dampening Field mandatory +2 RP component remains and final Resonance Influence Ease -1 produces 1 RP. Field eligibility remains at actual legal cast commitment, not ritual resolution.

Current Summon Spectral Steed counts a Medium rider body as 6 Load before equipment. Body 160 lb/6 Load plus gear 20 lb/2 Load equals 180 lb/8 Load, within 350 lb/12 Load and therefore Burdened, reducing Speed 60 to 50 ft. The Planar Crossing command, Action, spent crossing attempt, atomic origin retention on blocked destination, and continuing concentration all match the current reviewed procedure.

finalModuleVerdict.statement: The complete eight candidate payloads are accepted as the current NEW provisional authored playtest coherence reference for this bounded 15-spell AC4 module. No operative corrections remain from this exact review.
